title: Cochlear Implantation
description: CMS National Coverage Determination for Cochlear Implantation (NCD 50.3) for treatment of bilateral pre- or post-linguistic, sensorineural, moderate-to-profound hearing impairment.

criteria.name: Bilateral Moderate-to-Profound Sensorineural Hearing Loss
criteria.description: Diagnosis of bilateral moderate-to-profound sensorineural hearing impairment with limited benefit from appropriately fitted binaural hearing aids.
criteria.clinical_intent: Document severe bilateral sensorineural hearing impairment
entity_names: bilateral moderate to profound hearing loss
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: bilateral moderate-to-profound sensorineural hearing impairment with l

criteria.name: Speech Recognition Score Threshold (<= 40% to 60%)
criteria.description: Demonstrated limited benefit from amplification defined by sentence recognition test scores <= 40% (or up to <= 60% in approved protocols) in best-aided condition.
criteria.required_temporal_window: Clinical progress note or diagnostic report
criteria.source_text_excerpt: test scores of less than or equal to 60% correct in the best-aided listening

criteria.name: Cognitive Ability and Rehabilitation Suitability
criteria.description: Cognitive ability to use auditory clues, willingness to undergo an extended program of rehabilitation, and absence of middle ear infection.
criteria.clinical_intent: Rehabilitation readiness and anatomical candidate suitability
